scene.en: You are Adam. On your first morning at the language school you stop at the front desk, where Pan Jan works. You want the toilet and a coffee. He is pan to you, so be polite.

meaning.en: Good morning! How can I help?

replies.text: Dzień dobry! Przepraszam, gdzie jest toaleta?

meaning.en: Good morning! Excuse me, where is the toilet?

acceptedAnswers: Dzień dobry! Przepraszam, gdzie jest toaleta?

meaning.en: Hi! Where is the toilet?

note.en: *Cześć* is for friends and family. To Pan Jan say *dzień dobry*.

meaning.en: Good night! Where is the toilet?

note.en: *Dobranoc* is for bedtime. In the morning it is *dzień dobry*.

meaning.en: The toilet is over there, on the left.
Thank you! And where is the coffee?
Thanks! And where is the coffee?

note.en: *Dzięki* is casual, for friends. To Pan Jan say *dziękuję*.

replies.text: Nie ma za co. A gdzie jest kawa?

meaning.en: You're welcome. And where is the coffee?

note.en: *Nie ma za co* answers a thank-you. Here you are the one to thank him: *dziękuję*.

turns.says: Kawa i woda są tam, na prawo.

meaning.en: The coffee and the water are over there, on the right.
Sorry, I don't understand. Please repeat.
I don't know.

note.en: *Nie wiem* is for a question you can't answer. When you don't follow, say *nie rozumiem* and ask him to repeat: *proszę powtórzyć*.

meaning.en: I don't remember.

note.en: *Nie pamiętam* is for something you have forgotten. When you don't follow, say *nie rozumiem* and ask him to repeat: *proszę powtórzyć*.

meaning.en: The coffee is over there, on the right.
I understand! Thank you very much.
On the left?

note.en: He said *na prawo*, on the right. *Na lewo* is on the left.

meaning.en: Here you are.

note.en: *Proszę bardzo* is what you say when you give something, or answer a thank-you. Here you thank him: *dziękuję bardzo*.

turns.says: Nie ma za co. Miłego dnia!

meaning.en: You're welcome. Have a nice day!
Thank you, same to you! Goodbye.
Bye!

note.en: *Pa* is for friends and family. To Pan Jan say *do widzenia*.

meaning.en: Good morning!

note.en: That says hello. Pan Jan is saying goodbye, so wish him the same: *nawzajem*.

meaning.en: Goodbye!
